note: Town of Diamond Valley campground in Turner Valley, run by the Foothills Lions Club with an on-site camp host, beside the pool and spray park and within walking distance of the Sheep River and downtown. Sites 1-5 are about 25 ft, for small units. Hot water from mid-May. No dump station on site: registered guests use the one at the Lions' Bob Lochhead campground in Black Diamond free. --Claude
